newsitem.title: USA: Goldman names Zuckerberg, Hurst vice-chairmen.
newsitem.headline: Goldman names Zuckerberg, Hurst vice-chairmen.

text.p: Goldman, Sachs and Co said Thursday it named Roy Zuckerberg and Robert Hurst vice chairmen of the company.
Zuckerberg, who joined the firm in 1967, will also continue as division head of equities. Hurst, who joined the firm in 1974, will also continue as head of investment banking.
The company said that as a result of the moves, the title of its vice chairman and chief operating officer, Henry Paulson, will change to president and chief operating officer.
The position of president is newly created, the firm said.
